text: Presentations on the introduction of investment managers will be given by: - Grace Xiang, Director Business Development and Client Partnerships, and John Stilo, Senior Portfolio Manager, Addenda Capital Inc.; and - Martin Dionne, Assistant Vice President Liability Driven Investments, Bob Moffat, Senior Vice President Institutional Markets, Stéphane Jean, Head of Liability Driven Investments, and Peter Osborne, Vice President and Portfolio Manager, Fiera Capital Corporation.
The Toronto Investment Board received the item for information.
